day1_opening_2.text: *Cherry blossoms drift through the air. The breeze slips in through the sleeves of my new uniform.*

day1_opening_3.text: *The uniform is still stiff. It smells faintly of starch. The creases I pressed into it yesterday spring back whenever I bend my knees.*

day1_opening_4.text: *Starting today, I'm a student at this school.*

day1_opening_5.text: *A transfer student. It couldn't be helped, not with my parents' jobs. In my uniform pocket, the transfer papers press against my fingertips along their old folds.*

day1_opening_6.text: *This morning, I texted Minsu: 'First day today.' Still just one gray check. The group chat from my old school is quiet too.*

day1_opening_7.text: *A cherry blossom petal brushes the tip of my nose. I turn my head before I can sneeze.*

day1_opening_8.text: *From inside the school, the bell rings briefly. It hasn't started yet, but my steps quicken a little.*

day1_gate_1.text: *I stand before the gates of an unfamiliar school.*

day1_gate_2.text: *The school is large and spotless. Beyond the broad field, morning sunlight lies in neat bands across the building's windows.*

day1_gate_3.text: *Students stream through the main gate in twos and threes. Laughter and chatter. Keys rattle in tracksuit pockets. Someone's worn sleeve brushes against my new one.*

day1_gate_4.text: *No one looks my way. Only the unfamiliar sleeves of my new uniform brush against my wrists.*

day1_gate_5.text: *One deep breath. I push the transfer papers deeper into my pocket and walk through the gate.*

day1_gate_cctv_1.text: *I pass through the main gate. There's a CCTV camera beside the pillar. Another where the wall turns the corner. One more at the entrance. The red indicator light blinks at a steady interval.*

day1_hallway_1.text: *I stop at the first junction in the hallway.*

day1_hallway_2.text: *Even with the directory in front of me, I can't make sense of the classroom layout. First-year building, second-year building, main building... annex?*

day1_hallway_3.text: *I glance at the directory as I walk, then turn right.*

day1_sea_meet_1.text: Are you the transfer student? I heard someone was coming today.

day1_sea_meet_2.text: *I turn around. A neatly dressed girl is standing there.*

day1_sea_meet_3.text: *Brown twin tails. Not a hair, ribbon, or name tag out of place.*

day1_sea_meet_4.text: *The moment our eyes meet, she smiles.*

day1_sea_meet_5.text: I'm Sea, the class rep. You're {name}, right?

day1_sea_meet_6.text: Uh, yeah. That's me. How do you know my name?

day1_sea_meet_7.text: Our homeroom teacher told me. She said ahead of time that we'd be getting a transfer student.

day1_sea_meet_9.text: *Of course the class rep would know in advance.*

day1_sea_meet_10.text: Looking for our classroom? Come on. I'll show you the way.

day1_sea_meet_11.text: *She takes the lead. Whenever {name} falls behind, she slows to match pace without looking back.*

day1_sea_meet_12.text: This is the science lab. The music room is down there. The second floor is mostly for third-years, so you won't need it much.

day1_sea_meet_13.text: The school store is at the end of the first floor. The line gets long at lunch.

day1_sea_meet_14.text: Wow, you sound like you've memorized the whole place. Is that a class-rep thing?

day1_sea_meet_15.text: I am the class rep. So... I guess it is.

day1_sea_meet_16.text: *The corners of her mouth lift for a moment.*

day1_sea_meet_17.text: If the new kid gets lost, it's the class rep's job to help.

day1_sea_meet_18.text: *Students naturally make way wherever she goes. {name} follows behind her.*

day1_gate_ngp_turn_back.text: *My feet stop. The moment I try to turn around, the screen bleeds slowly into white. Sound recedes into the distance.*

day1_gate_ngp_classroom.text: *I open my eyes. A classroom. I'm sitting at my desk in the back row by the window. The date on the board is today's.*

day1_gate_ngp_teacher_2.text: *My mind is blank. I was about to do something. What was it?*

day1_choco_ngp_1.text: Oh, right. Here. I got it from the school store. You didn't bring anything, did you?

day1_choco_ngp_2.text: *Sea hands me a carton of strawberry milk. Condensation beads against my palm.*

day1_choco_ngp_3.text: *My fingers find the end of the straw wrapper without thinking. I've never held this carton before, yet even its folded corners feel familiar.*

day1_choco_1.text: *On the way to the classroom, Sea takes a small carton out of her bag.*

day1_choco_2.text: Oh, right. Want a chocolate milk? It was buy one, get one free, so I have one left.

day1_choco_3.text: *She holds out a small chocolate milk carton.*

day1_choco_5.text: Oh? Thanks, but... what's the occasion?

day1_choco_6.text: Your hands are freezing. Morning classes are rough on an empty stomach. At least drink this.

choices: How did you know I liked this?
Actually, strawberry milk is more my thing.

day1_choco_accept_1.text: *I push in the straw and take a sip. The sweetness hits hard.*

day1_choco_accept_3.text: Chocolate is usually a safe bet.

day1_choco_accept_4.text: *The carton is still cold. Sea folds the straw wrapper into a small square and slips it into her pocket.*

day1_choco_question_1.text: Wait. How did you know I like chocolate milk?

day1_choco_question_2.text: *The smile at the corners of her mouth goes stiff. She blinks once, then smiles again.*

day1_choco_question_3.text: I told you, it was buy one, get one free. They had strawberry too, but chocolate seemed like the safer choice.

day1_choco_question_6.text: *She smiles. Her fingers pause for the briefest moment over the straw wrapper, then resume folding it.*

day1_choco_joke_2.text: *Her hand stills over the straw wrapper. Just for a moment.*

day1_choco_joke_3.text: Oh, really? I'll bring strawberry next time. It was in the left slot at the snack shop.

day1_classroom_1.text: *With Sea leading the way, I reach the classroom.*

day1_classroom_2.text: *The moment I open the door and step inside, every eye in the room fixes on me.*

day1_classroom_3.text: *Whispers ripple through the room. 'That's the transfer student.' 'Where'd they come from?' Somewhere, a chair scrapes across the floor with a jarring squeal.*

day1_classroom_4.text: *I set down my bag and take my seat by the window. Cherry blossoms are visible outside.*

day1_classroom_5.text: *As the chatter continues, the classroom door opens and our homeroom teacher walks in.*

day1_eunsu_1.text: *A young teacher in glasses, with a gentle face.*

day1_eunsu_2.text: All right, everyone. We have a new transfer student joining us today.

day1_eunsu_4.text: {name}, would you like to come up and introduce yourself?

day1_eunsu_5.text: *At the front of the room, the smell of chalk dust is stronger. Someone shifts in their chair near the back.*

day1_eunsu_6.text: Welcome. We're glad to have you.

day1_eunsu_7.text: *When Ms. Eunsu finishes speaking, my clenched fingers slowly uncurl.*

day1_eunsu_9.text: Hello. I'm {name}. I just transferred here. It's nice to meet you all.

day1_eunsu_10.text: Any hobbies or things you like?

day1_eunsu_11.text: Um... I like listening to music.

day1_eunsu_12.text: *The students laugh softly. Someone in the back mutters, "Me too."*

day1_eunsu_13.text: That'll do. Everyone, make {name} feel welcome. Your seat is in the back row by the window.

day1_eunsu_14.text: *I head back to my seat. Sea gives me a thumbs-up. Ms. Eunsu offers a slight nod.*

day1_seolhwa_1.text: *Before second period begins, I glance over my shoulder.*

day1_seolhwa_3.text: *Her pale hair is tousled, as if she never brushed it this morning. She stares out the window.*

day1_seolhwa_4.text: *Conversation dies out only around her desk. Chin in hand, she keeps staring outside, eyelids slightly lowered.*

day1_seolhwa_5.text: *A boy with glasses also sits alone in the far corner, reading a manga. Chairs seem to scrape more quietly in that row.*

choices: Hi, I'm {name}. Looks like I'll be sitting in front of you.

day1_seolhwa_greet_2.text: Hi, I'm {name}. Nice to meet you.

day1_seolhwa_greet_4.text: *The corners of her mouth lift a little, then quickly fall. Her ears are red.*

day1_seolhwa_greet_5.text: *After a brief pause, she speaks in a tiny voice.*

day1_seolhwa_greet_7.text: *One word. That's all. She turns her gaze back out the window. There isn't an open textbook or even a pencil case on her desk.*

day1_seolhwa_greet_8.text: Hey, transfer kid. Who were you talking to back there?

day1_seolhwa_greet_9.text: I said hi to the girl behind me, but she didn't answer.

day1_seolhwa_greet_10.text: Oh, her? I've almost never seen her talk to anyone. She's been like that since first year.

day1_seolhwa_greet_11.text: *I look back. The girl is staring out the window. The boy with glasses in the corner hasn't looked up from his manga either.*

day1_seolhwa_greet_12.text: I see. The quiet type, huh.

day1_seolhwa_greet_13.text: She answers sometimes if you talk to her. I've never seen her speak first. I don't know her name either.

day1_seolhwa_greet_14.text: *For a moment, her profile overlaps my reflection in the window behind us.*

day1_seolhwa_skip.text: *I should focus on class. This isn't the time to worry about whoever's behind me.*

day1_dejavu2_1.text: *During class, I dropped my pencil and looked under the desk.*

day1_dejavu2_2.text: *There are scratches on the underside of the desk, gouged in with a pencil or compass. They're old and faded.*

day1_dejavu2_3.text: *I can make out a few strokes of letters. A line curving left, a mark that looks like a number. When I scratch it with my nail, dust comes away.*

day1_dejavu2_4.text: *I pick up the pencil and turn back toward the board.*

day1_break_1.text: *Break time. A few boys come over.*

day1_break_2.text: Hey, transfer kid. Where'd you come from?

day1_break_4.text: What have you been into lately?

day1_break_5.text: *We talk about places near school, then drift to the music we've been listening to. When someone gets my name wrong twice, Sea corrects them from beside me.*

day1_break_6.text: Hey, Sea's really looking out for you.

day1_break_7.text: That's what she's like when class-rep mode kicks in.

day1_break_8.text: But she's never brought a lunchbox before, has she?

day1_pe_1.text: *P.E. class. Soccer. The ball went high. I trapped it with my left foot.*

day1_pe_4.text: *A camera shutter clicks from one corner of the field. A small girl holding a camera flinches.*

day1_pe_yuna_1.text: Oh, sorry. I'm taking documentary photos for the photography club...

day1_pe_yuna_2.text: I'm Choi Yuna, a first-year. I help photograph official school events.

day1_pe_yuna_3.text: I'll be sorting the photos in the library after school. If you'd rather I delete yours, just let me know then.

day1_pe_wall_1.text: *After soccer, I sit on a bench and drink some water. Green wire mesh runs along the top of the red-brick wall, with mountains visible beyond it. One section of the fence is bent slightly inward.*

day1_pe_wall_3.text: *The bell rang, so I headed back to the classroom.*

day1_xover_seolhwa_1.text: *As I walk down the hallway, I see someone standing at the far end, beyond the reach of the light.*

day1_xover_seolhwa_4.text: *I blink. No one is there. Just an empty hallway. For a moment, the scent of antiseptic replaces the cherry blossoms.*

day1_xover_seolhwa_5.text: *What was that? The smell of antiseptic still lingers.*
